title: comastoma pulmonarium subsp. arrectum
intro: Comastoma pulmonarium subsp. arrectum, commonly known as the Himalayan lungwort, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the gentian family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the Himalayan lungwort include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
